# ExoNova Solutions

> ExoNova Solutions is a digital agency based in Islamabad, Pakistan, delivering web design, web development, SEO, digital marketing, graphics designing and custom software for growing businesses. Founded in 2021, the team has completed 250+ projects for 150+ clients.

## Services
- Web Designing — responsive, on-brand UI/UX design
- Web Development — custom websites and web applications
- SEO — technical, on-page and local search optimization
- Digital Marketing — paid social, search ads, email automation
- Graphics Designing — brand identity, social and print creative
- Custom Software — tailored internal tools and platforms
